title: Zutty Singleton as a drummer
summary: They praise Zutty as a fine drummer who played the Lyric Theater shows, and Russell returns to lessons.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Yeah, Zutty was a fine drummer. I heard him last summer and it was something else to see a man like that you know. Yeah.
Yeah. It was a real light after Zutty left. And then who else was in the band?
I can't remember now. Was it a big band or?
No, Dick was a small band. Small band.
Was Zutty considered a good drummer then? Fine drummer.
Correct. Played all the shows up at the Lyric Theater.
Professor Robichaud's band. Yeah, Zutty was a fine drummer.

I heard him last summer and it was something else to see a man like that you know. I realized how great he was in person although I appreciated him on records I never really appreciated him. You did see him in Poison?
Yeah. You like him in Poison?
Oh yeah, he's wonderful. That's a good drummer. He was telling me about when he played with the Tuxedo Orchestra. That's right.
Oh yeah. Well he's most house drummer around New York.

To get back to some of your lessons again I wondered what method do you remember if you were going to have a little trouble with it. Our machine looks like we're going to have a little trouble with it. Stop there dead for a minute but we'll try to finish up as soon as we can.
We better repeat that method. Yeah. What method was that?
